name: Red Dot Sight
description: A compact optic that improves close-to-mid range aiming without obstructing the view.

name: Extended Mag
description: Increases magazine capacity allowing longer sustained fire before reload.

name: Heavy Barrel
description: A reinforced barrel that improves projectile stability for long-range shots.

name: Muzzle Brake
description: Redirects propellant gases to counteract recoil. May increase muzzle flash/noise.

name: Suppressor
description: Reduces firing sound and muzzle flash at the cost of range and slightly reduced damage at distances.

name: Laser Pointer
description: Small laser to aid hip-fire accuracy and quick target acquisition.

name: Incendiary Rounds
description: Ammunition mod that swaps the primary fire mode's rounds for incendiary ones, changing its damage type from Ballistic to Heat.
